title: ChemBART: Pre-training a Reaction Language Model for Comprehensive Synthesis Planning
abstract: arXiv:2601.02915v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated transformative potential across diverse fields. However, in computer-aided synthesis planning (CASP), current LLM methodologies are often restricted to single-molecule representations, limiting their application to isolated, single-task scenarios such as precursor prediction. Addressing this gap, we present ChemBART, a BART-based language model that adopts a reaction-centric pre-training strategy. By leveraging a mask-filling pre-training task on holistic reaction expressions (Reactant > Reagent > Product), ChemBART effectively solves a variety of chemical problems, including precursor/reagent generation, temperature-yield regression, and molecular property classification. translated_title: ChemBART：用于综合合成规划的化学反应语言模型预训练
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展已在多个领域展现出变革性潜力。然而，在计算机辅助合成规划（CASP）领域，当前的LLM方法通常局限于单分子表示，这限制了其在孤立的单任务场景（如前体预测）中的应用。为填补这一空白，我们提出了ChemBART，一个基于BART架构、采用以反应为中心的预训练策略的语言模型。通过在整体反应表达式（反应物 > 试剂 > 产物）上进行掩码填充预训练任务，ChemBART能够有效解决多种化学问题，包括前体/试剂生成、温度-产率回归以及分子性质分类。基于这些能力，我们展示了将ChemBART与蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）相集成以进行多步合成路线设计，其中该模型用于优化策略和……
tldr: ChemBART是一种以反应为中心进行预训练的BART语言模型，通过在整体反应表达式上进行掩码填充预训练，能够统一解决前体/试剂生成、产率回归、分子性质分类等多种化学任务，并可与蒙特卡洛树搜索结合实现多步合成路线设计。
en_tdlr: ChemBART is a reaction-centric pre-trained BART language model that, through mask-filling pre-training on holistic reaction expressions, unifies diverse chemical tasks including precursor/reagent generation, yield regression, and property classification, and can be integrated with Monte Carlo tree search for multi-step synthesis route design.
